name: A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
description: Founder-Acharya of ISKCON, author of numerous translations of sacred scriptures. Spread Krishna consciousness worldwide.

name: HH Radhanath Swami
description: Author of "The Journey Home", inspiring spiritual teacher and storyteller.

name: HH Bhakti Vijnana Goswami
description: Disciple of Gopal Krishna Goswami and one of the leading ISKCON preachers in Russia, lecturing in Russian.

name: HH Niranjana Swami
description: Disciple of Srila Prabhupada who has served ISKCON in Russia and Ukraine for decades.

name: HH Indradyumna Swami
description: Disciple of Srila Prabhupada, known for the festival tours of Poland and his travelling preaching around the world.

name: HH Sivarama Swami
description: Disciple of Srila Prabhupada, author and leader of ISKCON in Hungary, founder of the Krishna Valley eco-village.

name: HH Kadamba Kanana Swami
description: Disciple of Srila Prabhupada, beloved for his kirtans and preaching across Europe, South Africa and Russia.

name: HH Bhakti Caitanya Swami
description: Disciple of Srila Prabhupada, serving ISKCON in South Africa and regularly preaching in Russia and the Baltic states.

name: HH Jayapataka Swami
description: Disciple of Srila Prabhupada, who has guided the development of Sridham Mayapur since the 1970s.

name: HG Chaitanya Charan Das
description: Disciple of Radhanath Swami, engineer by training, author and editor of The Spiritual Scientist.
